title: Redo firstmate work-handling study with a real pinned commit SHA
summary: Retry the study of firstmate's work handling (M1), fixing the prior failure: use the real resolved commit SHA from pinned-source/ in pin.json and every claim, make validation reproducible by a kept test, and fix the minor claim/model inaccuracies.

defaults_applied.how: Claims cite path, lines, SHA and verbatim quote from the pinned tree.
Validation must be reproducible by a kept test the verifier can run.
cargo test, clippy and fmt pass.
Study text is written for outside readers.
JSON study files are listed in docs/non-rust-files.md with a reason.
The retry's requirements were recovered from the quoted verifier findings.

assumptions: The prior output is not on disk (studies/ absent), so the study is redone from scratch.
pinned-source/ is mounted at dispatch and gives the real commit SHA of firstmate at ref main.
If the SHA cannot be resolved the job should stop rather than use a placeholder.
The validator in crates/ can be run or extended by a kept test to reproduce validation.

acceptance_criteria.text: studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json holds a full 40-hex commit SHA resolved from the mounted pinned-source tree, with a date and resolution method; no placeholder such as UNRESOLVED-PIN-SHA appears anywhere in the study.
Every file citation in claims.json and rationales.json carries that same SHA, a path and line range that exist in the pinned tree, and a verbatim quote.

Run cargo test: the study validator and tests (kept in the repository, not temporary) pass on studies/firstmate-work-handling, including the wrong-SHA and quote-match rules against real pinned-source text.
Every claim has enforcement tagged mechanism or prose-only (no 'not examined'), and model transitions with guard 'none' do not claim code evaluates a guard.
Any new non-Rust file type is listed with its reason in docs/non-rust-files.md, and the change is named in CHANGELOG.md.
cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy report no problems.

out_of_scope: Changing athena.toml or other governance files
departures: Study jobs are larger than the typical change in the reference history: many cited claims plus a model, with exact quote checks, so cost and time are higher and pass probability lower.
